title: Add slugify() with its edge cases to a small library
goal: Add a function slugify(text, max_len=None) to textkit.py. Rules: the result is lowercase ASCII; letters with diacritics become their base letter ("Žltý kôň" -> "zlty-kon"); every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes a single hyphen; the result never starts or ends with a hyphen; with max_len the result is at most max_len characters long and still never ends with a hyphen; text with no letters or digits gives an empty string. tests/test_slugify.py already describes the basics -- make it pass, and add your own tests for the edge cases in a new file tests/test_slugify_edges.py. Do not change the existing test files.
